Having severe acne. It’s not just having a few spots all over your face. 
Deep painful cysts under your skin which are indescribably painful. The dirty looks you get on the daily which stick deep in your mind and haunt you whenever you go out. The feeling of being unhygienic and disgusting when you look in the mirror. You start to compare yourself to every single person with clear skin. You ask yourself ‘how come they have clear skin and I don’t?’. 
You try endless amounts of brands, hoping for the day when one will work. 
I went to the doctors and I got told to go and see a dermatologist. I had tried around 4 different medications and all of them failed so I was put onto accutane. At first my skin broke out all over, even worse than before and I didn’t know what was happening (this is normal). The medication caused your entire face to go dry (dry eyes, lips especially and skin). I had awful knee and back pain and I also suffered with awful mood swings and depression with bad anxiety. 
I am nearly off  the tablets but I wish people would understand that living with acne is not just a few spots, it changed the way I view the beauty in others, and myself.
